decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-21796119) focuses on the genomic landscape of Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) and Follicular Lymphoma (FL), identifying genes under positive selection for mutations (e.g., BCL2, MYD88, EZH2, MLL2, SGK1). The text does not mention Acral Lentiginous Melanoma, TERT amplification, or any prognostic significance related to TERT status in melanoma. Therefore, there is insufficient evidence to support, revise, or refute the claim regarding TERT amplification as a poor prognostic factor in Acral Lentiginous Melanoma.
